speaker: alse_pinder
text: He is on the Chaucer. I am not staying to see if he agrees with it. The chronicle is a tall book and a cat is heavy, and I have done the lifting.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Down, then. The latch is the latch. I am not calling the house again tonight. The sheet stays, and the fold stays, and both of them are mine to ignore.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I am on the second turning already. If you call, I will think it is the cat, and I will be wrong, and I will be annoyed. Good night, sir.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good night. That is the second time, and it is the last.
